Description: NIH Research Project Grant: supports a discrete, specified, circumscribed research project in an area representing the specific interests and competencies of the investigator(s).
NIH Exploratory/Developmental Research Grant: supports the early and conceptual stages of project development, encouraging new, exploratory, and high-risk/high-reward research.
NIH Method to Extend Research in Time (MERIT) Award: extended, non-competing funding provided to investigators with an R01 who have demonstrated superior competence and productivity.
NIH Research Project Cooperative Agreement: supports a discrete, specified research project in which substantial programmatic involvement by NIH staff is anticipated.
NIH Resource-Related Research Projects Cooperative Agreement: supports research and development of resources that will enhance the capability of researchers to conduct research.
NIH Specialized Center Cooperative Agreement: supports a multi-project, multi-disciplinary research center with substantial NIH programmatic involvement.
